plainText:
Emily Woo Zeller is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Zeller was born on November 11, 1983. As an adult, she became a voice actress and was involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. Zeller was mostly involved with , which broadcasted Japanese anime, including alternate English-dubbed versions, in other Asian countries. She began working for during the , voicing two major characters: Team Flare scientist Bryony and Arche Valley resident Meray.
